kernel_branch.scope: Version tuple comparison only; no patch-state inference

limitations: This only compares the selected 5.4.61 FCM5 kernel branches against the exported config.
No full merged framework/device manifests, APEX fragments, HAL version/range matching, VNDK or sepolicy compatibility evaluation.
The ext4 reader handles only bounded regular files/directories with extents; no filesystem checksum validation or independent extractor used.
Successful config subset matching does not prove DSU boot, AVB trust, early mounting or runtime HAL compatibility.
